# Langar Finder — LLMs.txt

> A community-driven website to discover and share verified Gurudwaras and
> free langar (community meals) across India and internationally.

## What this site does

Langar Finder maps and indexes thousands of Gurudwaras, regular feeders, and
historical shrines. Visitors can search by city, region, distance, or meal
timing; community members can submit and verify new listings.

## Key URLs

- Homepage: https://langarfind.com/
- Search all langars: https://langarfind.com/search
- Gurudwara directory: https://langarfind.com/gurudwaras
- Map view: https://langarfind.com/map
- Add a listing: https://langarfind.com/add
- About: https://langarfind.com/about
- Help & FAQ: https://langarfind.com/help
- Privacy Policy: https://langarfind.com/privacy
- Terms of Use: https://langarfind.com/terms
- Contact: https://langarfind.com/contact

## Popular cities covered

Amritsar, Delhi, Jalandhar, Ludhiana, Phagwara, Anandpur Sahib, Patiala,
Bathinda, Chandigarh, Mohali.

## Content policy

All listings are community-submitted and moderated. Langar is always free —
this platform is too. Do not scrape or reproduce listings without attribution.
